text:
Alex (Growth): Quick thread 10min sync: pushing a shortened nurture for the new benchmark post. goal: drive signups + webinar regs.
Priya Rao: I trimmed the copy to make it a 60s read. two subject options: technical (benchmarks) vs outcome (saves).
Jordan (Content): technical subject: 'Benchmark: 3x token savings in the wild'
Jordan (Content): outcome subject: 'Cut inference cost, keep the quality'
Maya (Design): updated templates in Figma, mobile-first. hero -> single sentence, CTA prominent.
Alex (Growth): let's AB subject to 10k each. segment by intent: high-intent (docs clicks last 14d), medium (newsletter opens 30d), low (rest).
Riley (Deliverability): recommend seeded canary 300 users total (100 per segment) + seed accounts. run suppression sweep today.
Nora (Ops): canary window Tue 08:30 PT. Full send Thu with regional windows: APAC morning, EMEA lunchtime, NA morning PT. throttle policy: 20k/hr with adaptive backoff.
Priya Rao: preview lines tested:
- Technical: "short read: latency + cost metrics"
- Outcome: "practical savings for infra teams"
Jordan (Content): my pick: technical subject + outcome preview. curiosity opener for engineers.
Maya (Design): will shorten the hero to 38 chars to avoid truncation. added alt text for images to help deliverability.
Riley (Deliverability): headers to include:
```
X-Redwood-Test: nurture-3132100000
List-Unsubscribe: <https://redwood.example.com/unsub>
```
Riley (Deliverability): also enable domain-specific link wrapping for APAC and set TTL 72h.
Alex (Growth): CTA variants: primary -> /use-cases, alt -> /blog/benchmark-summary. test which lifts trial signups.
Priya Rao: added UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=bench_jul. pushed final copy to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sr/marketing/news-nurture-3132 (draft).
Nora (Ops): deploy-bot scheduled the canary: "canary-send id=canary-3132100000 users=300 time=2024-07-02T15:30:00Z"
deploy-bot: scheduled send created (canary-3132100000) :white_check_mark:
Alex (Growth): after canary we'll review: opens, CTR to /use-cases, bounces, spam complaints. if bounces spike >0.7% we pause and run suppression.
Jordan (Content): i'll prep two short follow-ups for non-openers: 48h and 96h, subject tuned to urgency.
Maya (Design): i'll be on standby to adjust template if canary heatmap shows poor CTR zones.
Riley (Deliverability): will post canary deliverability report here within 40m of completion.
Alex (Growth): thanks team 10: final signoff Mon EOD.
